note: Every production change since the accepted B++ head (143b63f), by the file's old name, with the stage that made it and why. dev/tools/gate/scope_m.js fails on any runtime difference not listed here, and on a listed one that did not happen. Stage 3H2 made the first seven (its report, dev/stage-3h/3H2_REPORT.md); the engine modernization adds its own as it goes. A server module made after the modernization has no old name: it is listed by its own path.

H3M-1: the web root is public/; the moved modules and the generated sim.js are required from their new paths. Post-3H Trial 2 (owner's integration pack of 2026-10-15; docs/architecture/CHAT.md): it requires the chat's three modules (W.A.R.D.'s chat_text.js, B++'s lounge.js and speech.js) and registers one upgrade dispatcher: /social to the lounge, every other request to the session's own handler as before (the session registers it on the object it is given); the session is given speech.readerFor(reader), the same reader but for {t:'say'}, which the session never read. changed.mp.js: 3H2 C-3 and C-4: NEW RUN's button and run-menu words, and the fluorescent hum, moved to assets/net-newrun.js and assets/mp-hum.js. Continuation C3c (M-024): its 16 owned parts are 11 modules and a composition (ADR-005): each owner's state is its own and the others call its functions; the session (B++) gets the modules made after it once, through wire(). 863 of M8's 921 lines are as they were and every other line is listed with its reason (dev/stage-3h-modernization/tools/c3c_mp_provenance.js); the 18 client scenes give B++'s traces byte for byte and run every function (the gate's cli_golden step) Post-3H Trial 2 (docs/architecture/CHAT.md): B++'s session links its send of {t:'say'} into F.R.O.N.T.'s window.__chat (window.__chat.link, once, if chat.js is loaded; window.__net is unchanged) and hands it 'heard' and 'said' with the speaker's peer record; core's per-frame hook calls window.__chatFrame after drawing the other players (as it calls __glitchFrame). Every B++ scene's trace unchanged (cli_golden); the send is listed as made and run only by dev/tools/checks/chat_browser.js. Trial 4: attached bounded sender HUD color to speech send, without adding window.__net API.

added.src/frameworks/lost/shared/level0.json: Continuation C4c (M-003): Level 0's one definition (L.O.S.T.): the map's size, the rooms, the corridors, partitions, doorways and pits, the pillars, the spawn and the reachability anchor beside it, the blackout timer. The server's level module reads it (given by src/core/server/sim.js) and the compiled client is built with it (src/core/client/game/level-data.cjs), so the two sides cannot drift. Its values are the ones both sides wrote before: c4c_level0_check.js (the server), the alpha check and the bundle's bytes (the client).
added.src/frameworks/pocket/shared/lights.json: Continuation C4c (M-003): the carried lights' one table (P.O.C.K.E.T.): reach, spread, strength, spill, all-around, night vision. The server's level module reads it (the light a player's equipment gives, as the monsters perceive it) and the compiled client is built with it (LIGHT_SPECS). The server's own copy labelled the camcorder "Night Vision Camcorder"; the table holds the page's "Camcorder" (with nv): no server code reads a label or nv, and the server goldens, which record every byte the server sends, are B++'s.
